investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Amberent Mobile (mobile operator); Platform: Google Cloud asia-south1 (zones asia-south1-a/asia-south1-b/asia-south1-c); network range 10.130.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ambere-prod-asiaso (GKE); Database tier: self-managed postgres primary/replica on virtual machines with provider block storage, replica in another zone; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
